comment.author: @ae_double
comment.text:
I never got the original (or any MP) so getting a chance to get a new one in cartoon colours felt like a good way to dive into it.
As to why recolour an old toy, I must imagine a lot of factors in mind. I don't know if they want to do full cartoon accurate toys as much these days with MPG, but I assume the old MP13 is still considered a very good toy by today's standards, that it might've been more cost effective to reuse instead of making a somewhat different looking toy that functions the same way. (I'm not sure how audiences feel about the more expensive and complex designed cartoon accurate MPs these days, but that's possibly another factor.)
And with Blaster and his cassettes getting a lot of design focus and budget, this might be a more budget friendly way to get Soundwave and his cassettes in the market again to pair them up together. Without hearing from the designers themselves, these feel like the most probable reasons for going this way.
